items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Then I had to tell what happened to my friend Lola.

ctx.x: Then this -- let me see. Let me see, now, later I think he must have called -- he called his wife, he called Lola Wynne, who was his wife, and told her, because they didn't live too far from us at that time, so he called his wife and told Lola Wynne to -- he says, "Be sure and go by Nellie's house. Nellie's had her baby." And Lola gave a scream, "What? Had the baby?" So then later she came by.

Well, now, here I had to tell it to my sister Florida. Then I had to tell what happened to my friend Lola. Then when my husband came home, well you know I had to tell him. He just was absolutely just baffled. He didn't know what to say. "Well, I wonder why this happened," he said. "Why did it happen?" I said, "I don't know. God did it. I don't know."
What an experience. And by yourself it happened.
